title: Pin Equivariance and Local Dirac Boundary Problems on the Flat Mobius Band
summary: We study complex rank-two pinor fields on the flat Möbius band and the relation between their deck equivariance and Dirac boundary realizations. With explicit Clifford conventions, the two lifts for each Pin type are represented by $R=cσ_1$, where $c=\pm1$ for Pin+ and $c=\pm i$ for Pin-. The relevant longitudinal monodromy is $cJ$, with $Jφ(w)=σ_1φ(-w)$, rather than the fiber matrix alone. Its eigenspaces give shifts $0,1/2$ in the positive case and $1/4,3/4$ in the negative case.
